title: The Religion of Speed
summary: A philosophical exploration of how speed optimization has become a deeply held belief system in software engineering culture, examining the dogmas and trade-offs that come with treating performance as a sacred imperative rather than a practical consideration.
problem_solved: Explores the cultural phenomenon where developers treat speed optimization as a religious conviction rather than a balanced engineering decision.
why_valuable: Offers a critical perspective on tech culture's obsession with speed, helping developers recognize when performance pursuit becomes counterproductive dogma.
